name: cflow
description: Personal collection of Claude Code plugins: skills, agents and workflows by ahlerjam.

plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: Side pane next to the chat that switches every skill, plugin, MCP server and agent on, off or never, and shows GitHub Actions runs and issues of the current repo.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Third-party, by blader: rewrites AI-sounding English text so it reads like the writer. Listed here as a dependency of useful-tools.

plugins.name: humanizer-de
plugins.description: Third-party, by marmbiz: German style editor that finds and removes AI writing patterns. Listed here as a dependency of useful-tools.

plugins.name: slice
plugins.description: Plans a spec and an E2E feature list, then one long run session builds and proves each feature.

plugins.name: useful-tools
plugins.description: Session tools: handover files for the next session, source-backed web research from quick answers to full dossiers, and editable draw.io diagrams without the desktop app.
